description:
Found by fz-kdt.69.3's build: when one publisher's ActivationInputs
contribution withdraws while other publishers remain, the resulting movement
is classified shift=false -- a NARROWING wearing an ascent's clothes
(observed at AnalyzeActivation(..Ty(324)) during the decommission
experiments). Harmless today only because withdrawal is impossible under
preservation (conclude_preserving_frontier never withdraws for
AnalyzeActivation -- the fz-kdt.64 asymmetry). The moment any route enables
withdrawal (fz-kdt.64's own resolution, or a future decommission), readers
join evidence that should have replaced. Gate fz-kdt.64 on deciding this.

comments.text: RIDER (fz-kdt.106 landed, a010532e8, 2026-09-01): still open and still gating fz-kdt.64. Note 106's prototype record: mid-drive value-level replace (narrowing) on ActivationInputs was twice refuted by non-settlement -- the grow-only property is load-bearing for termination. Any route that enables withdrawal must carry a termination argument, not just correct shift classification.

title: A withdrawn ActivationInputs contribution propagates as an ascent
